governance_bootstrap.summary: Harness is an operating system, not a summarizer; completion reporting must preserve human decision boundaries and exact verification.
Completion requires real user-facing/runtime verification evidence; Mac Mini production paths must be verified before complete reporting.

codex_cli_rule: Codex CLI uses caveman ultra by default unless explicitly disabled; code change summaries must keep changed files, verification, commit, and deploy state exact.
problem: OpenClaw timed out or failed when asked to check whether 10-year daewoon research material was added to the fixed Saju NotebookLM notebook.
root_cause: The request was a NotebookLM source/status check, but the exposed Saju tool path treated it as a fortune/query request and enforced birth-date and target-date requirements.
The NotebookLM CLI error path only reported exit code details and could hide the useful connection failure while risking raw stderr exposure.
OpenClaw did not expose the newly added optional status tool in the live dynamic tool list, so the existing harness_saju_query path needed a source-status fallback.
changes: scripts/openclaw_codex_bridge.py: added saju-notebook-sources read-only command with source_count, updated_at, source_revision, search matches, and privacy-safe audit hashing.
scripts/openclaw_codex_bridge.py: redacts bearer tokens, OAuth token fields, refresh-token shaped values, and JWT-shaped values from nlm failure details.
plugins/harness-bridge/index.js: added source-status intent detection, keyword extraction, and source-status fallback inside harness_saju_query for live OpenClaw compatibility.
plugins/harness-bridge/openclaw.plugin.json: declared harness_saju_notebook_status in the plugin contract.
tests/test_harness_bridge_plugin.mjs and tests/test_openclaw_bridge.py: added routing, source search, audit failure, and redaction regression coverage.
